text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Laurel won the Hanshin Daishoten. 
Witnessing her tremendous power, the 
spectators began placing immense 
expectations upon her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"To the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe 
alongside Narita Brian." With such talk 
arising, Sakura Laurel too lets her 
imagination wander to that dream 
possibility.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, news arrived that Narita Brian 
had suffered an injury and would skip the 
Tenno Sho (Spring). Even so, Sakura Laurel 
kept her eyes fixed straight ahead.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To attain strength like Narita Brian in a 
major race. For that very reason, she set 
her sights on the Tenno Sho (Spring) as 
planned.
